stories.headline: US strikes Iran in response to attack on cargo ship in Strait of Hormuz
stories.summary: The US military struck Iran in response to an Iranian drone attack on a cargo ship in the Strait of Hormuz. The drone strike occurred on Thursday, and the US retaliated on Friday. Iran had warned it would control the Strait of Hormuz and cautioned Gulf states against siding with Washington. Following the US attack, Tehran reported that cargo clearance had resumed. Additionally, Iran launched a drone assault on Bahrain, which is believed to be a response to the US strikes. The exchange of attacks has escalated tensions between the US and Iran, with each country accusing the other of aggression. The Strait of Hormuz is a critical waterway for international oil trade, and the conflict has significant implications for global security and economy. The situation remains volatile, with further developments expected.

stories.headline: Ukraine reportedly strikes Russian military plant in Volgograd
stories.summary: Ukraine struck a major Russian military plant in Volgograd overnight on June 27, using long-range Flamingo FP-5 missiles. The Titan-Barrikady military plant, a key facility in Russia's military-industrial complex, was reportedly hit. President Volodymyr Zelensky confirmed the strike, stating that Ukraine's long-range capabilities are expanding and putting pressure on Russia. The attack is part of Ukraine's efforts to increase costs for Russia and push for a peaceful resolution. The strike on the Volgograd plant follows recent Ukrainian attacks on Russian targets, including a natural gas plant and satellite centers. Meanwhile, Russian strikes continue to affect Ukrainian civilians, with one person killed and three wounded in a residential house in Izium, Kharkiv region. The escalation of strikes highlights the ongoing conflict between Ukraine and Russia.

stories.headline: Former Trump adviser John Bolton pleads guilty to mishandling classified information
stories.summary: John Bolton, former national security adviser to Donald Trump, has pleaded guilty to mishandling classified information. The charge relates to notes he compiled for a book, which contained national security information. Bolton's guilty plea was entered on Friday, and he could face prison time as a result. The inquiry into Bolton's handling of classified information spanned both the Trump and Biden administrations. He admitted to illegally retaining national security information, a charge that could result in imprisonment. Bolton served as national security adviser under Trump before being fired. His plea is a significant development in a case that has been ongoing for some time, and it remains to be seen what sentence he will receive. The guilty plea marks a notable consequence for a high-ranking former official.

stories.headline: UN envoy urges parties to ‘stay the course’ towards peace in eastern DR Congo
stories.summary: The UN envoy to the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has urged parties to "stay the course" towards achieving peace in the eastern region. The security situation remains highly unstable, with ongoing clashes in North Kivu and South Kivu resulting in a heavy toll on civilians. Despite the challenges, progress has been made, including the signing of the Washington Accords between the DRC and Rwanda, which UN Secretary-General António Guterres welcomed as an important step towards peace. The UN envoy emphasized that sustained commitment from all parties is necessary to achieve a lasting solution. The call for continued commitment comes after the UN withdrew its 15,000 peacekeepers from the DRC in September 2025, following a request from President Felix Tshisekedi. The envoy's statement highlights the need for parties to remain dedicated to the peace process.

stories.headline: HELIX Speaks: Learn Learn Learn Episode 17 Makes History as the First AI-Driven Episode, Official Website "HelixEngine.ai" Goes Live
stories.summary: HELIX has made history with the release of Learn Learn Learn Episode 17, the first episode to be fully scripted by AI from the ground up. This milestone marks a significant achievement in AI-driven content creation. Concurrently, the official website "HelixEngine.ai" has gone live, providing the world with its first glimpse into the capabilities of HELIX's AI engine. The launch of HelixEngine.ai and the AI-driven episode demonstrate the potential of AI in generating high-quality content. Episode 17 of Learn Learn Learn is a testament to the advancements in AI technology and its applications in creative fields. The website and episode are now available, offering a unique opportunity for the public to experience AI-generated content and explore the possibilities of HELIX's AI engine. This development is a notable step forward in the integration of AI in media and entertainment.

stories.headline: Hi3D Launches an AI-Powered Workflow for 3D Printing Creators
stories.summary: Hi3D has launched an AI-powered workflow for 3D printing creators, utilizing its intelligent segmentation system to analyze and separate models into logical printable components. The platform generates matching connector structures, including mortise-and-tenon joints and ball-joint assemblies. Powered by the proprietary Sparc3D AI model, Hi3D allows users to input a single reference image to generate high-quality 3D assets. This workflow is compatible with Bambu Lab 3D printers, enabling users to create multi-color 3D printed models from 2D images. The platform eliminates the need for public model libraries, allowing users to turn any drawing or AI-generated image into a 3D printable file. Additionally, Hi3D's AI 3D model generator enables easy creation of 3D models from images, text, and more, streamlining the process from design to manufacturing. This technology simplifies 3D printing, making it more accessible to creators.

stories.headline: baitesized (byte-sized) Launches to Bring Clarity to AI for Service Businesses
stories.summary: baitesized, also known as byte-sized, has launched to provide clarity on AI for service businesses. The platform aims to help businesses understand and adopt AI technology. This launch comes amid a broader effort to make AI more accessible, with companies like OpenAI, Anthropic, Amazon, and Microsoft signing on to support AI adoption. Former US Commerce Secretary Gina Raimondo is leading this initiative. The goal is to make AI more user-friendly and help businesses overcome technical hurdles. As AI continues to transform the labor market, efforts like baitesized and Agentic AI-as-a-Service are emerging to support businesses in navigating this change. With the launch of baitesized, service businesses can expect to gain a better understanding of how to leverage AI to improve their operations and stay competitive. The platform's launch is part of a larger trend towards making AI more accessible.

stories.headline: Mabinogi's 22nd Anniversary 'Fantasy Party' and Summer Update Preview
stories.summary: Nexon is celebrating Mabinogi's 22nd anniversary with a "Fantasy Party" offline event at KINTEX in Ilsan. The event will feature a showcase revealing the game's future update roadmap, live performances, and interactive activities. Director Choi Dong-min announced the RE:ACTION summer update, which includes the removal of the Near system, new Arcana Ascension growth elements, and the Tala Gah dungeon. The update also introduces major growth revamps and a new high-end dungeon. The celebration and update are part of Nexon's ongoing efforts to revamp and expand the game, following previous updates such as the New Rise Update, which overhauled dungeons, equipment, and the early game experience. The Fantasy Party event is scheduled to take place in June, with more details to be announced.

stories.headline: New Zealand vs Belgium LIVE: Watch FIFA World Cup Group G TV stream, score, lineups, commentary & updates Watch BBC TV coverage and follow live text commentary as New Zealand take on Belgium in Group G of the FIFA World Cup.
stories.summary: New Zealand faces Belgium in a crucial Group G match of the FIFA World Cup 2026 at BC Place in Vancouver. Both teams need a win to advance to the round of 32. The match is scheduled to take place on June 27, 2026. BBC TV will provide live coverage, and fans can also follow live text commentary. In the US, viewers can watch New Zealand's Group G matches, including this one, through various streaming options. Belgium previously drew a match, while New Zealand aims to secure a win. The teams' lineups and scores will be updated in real-time during the live broadcast. Fans can access additional information, including team news, ticket details, and stadium information, for the highly anticipated Group G clash. The match kicks off at 03:00, with live updates available throughout.

stories.headline: Bielsa takes the blame as Uruguay depart in a storm of spite and​ ill-discipline The head coach is an easy scapegoat but, while his legacy is secure, this has been a dire tournament for him and his side
stories.summary: Uruguay has been eliminated from the World Cup after the group stage for the second consecutive time. Head coach Marcelo Bielsa has taken responsibility for the team's poor performance, acknowledging it has been a dire tournament. Despite his legacy being secure due to his significant contributions to tactical history, Bielsa's recent results have been disappointing. The team's exit was marked by a storm of spite and ill-discipline. Bielsa had previously expressed feelings of shame after a 5-1 loss to the United States and accepted responsibility after a 2-2 draw with Cape Verde. In a recent press conference, Bielsa delivered an explosive rant, stating he is "toxic" amidst the team's dismal World Cup campaign. His future as coach remains uncertain despite his earlier commitment to continue through the 2026 World Cup.

stories.headline: FIFA World Cup 2026: Jubilant Cape Verde set date with Argentina in round of 32 Cape Verde makes history by reaching the World Cup round of 32, facing Argentina after a crucial draw with Saudi Arabia.
stories.summary: Cape Verde has made history by reaching the FIFA World Cup round of 32 after a 0-0 draw with Saudi Arabia. This achievement marks a significant milestone for the team, as they are debutants in the World Cup. The draw secured their spot in the knockout rounds, where they will face reigning champions Argentina. The match against Saudi Arabia ended in a goalless draw, but it was enough to propel Cape Verde into the next stage of the tournament. They will now face a challenging matchup against Argentina, the defending champions, in the round of 32. This unexpected clash is a notable upset, given Cape Verde's status as World Cup newcomers. The team's fairytale journey continues as they prepare to take on one of the tournament's top teams.

stories.headline: Uruguay's World Cup ends in failure, friction and no wins June 26 - Uruguay's World Cup ended on Friday as Marcelo Bielsa's side crashed out without a win, becoming the only CONMEBOL team not to reach the knockout round
stories.summary: Uruguay's World Cup campaign ended on Friday without a single win, making them the only CONMEBOL team to fail to reach the knockout rounds. Marcelo Bielsa's side was eliminated after a 1-0 defeat to Spain, having previously drawn with Saudi Arabia and Cape Verde. This outcome is particularly disappointing for Uruguay, a two-time World Cup champion. The team's exit has been marked by friction, with Bielsa taking full responsibility for the underwhelming performance, describing it as a "disgrace." The loss to Spain sealed their fate, and Uruguay's early departure from the tournament is a significant upset in a format designed to favor heavyweights like themselves.

stories.headline: Among beneficiaries of Centre’s scheme: wife, son, mother of IAS officer Three family members of Naresh Pal Gangwar, a senior IAS officer and Ministry Secretary, collectively claimed over ₹1.16 crore in NHB horticulture subsidies acr
stories.summary: A senior IAS officer's family members have been found to be beneficiaries of the Centre's horticulture subsidy scheme. Naresh Pal Gangwar, a Ministry Secretary, has three family members - his wife, son, and mother - who collectively claimed over ₹1.16 crore in subsidies from the National Horticulture Board. The scheme is under the Union Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers, and the family members are among the beneficiaries in Rajasthan. This development comes amid other reports of IAS officers being involved in controversies, including allegations of bribery, land fraud, and scamming awards. The Central Bureau of Investigation has also recently arrested individuals in connection with such cases, highlighting concerns about corruption and misuse of government schemes. An investigation is ongoing in the case of the IAS officer's family members.

stories.headline: Research paper retractions in India rise as 6 universities enter global top 10 India’s rise in global research rankings is now shadowed by a sharp spike in paper retractions. With six Indian universities among the world’s top 10 for retrac
stories.summary: India has seen a significant rise in research paper retractions, with six of its universities now among the world's top 10 for retractions. This spike in retractions comes as India's global research rankings improve, with its universities gaining international recognition. The increase in retractions is a concern, as it indicates a potential issue with the quality and integrity of research being conducted. The six Indian universities now among the top 10 for retractions highlight the need for greater responsibility and oversight in research practices. This trend is being closely watched, as it has implications for the credibility and reliability of research emerging from India's academic institutions. The country's rise in global rankings is overshadowed by this sharp spike in paper retractions, prompting calls for improved research standards and practices.

stories.headline: Nihangs breach security barricade, enter Dehradun; demand release of 4 arrested members, retreat after talks DEHRADOON: A tense standoff between Nihang Sikhs and Uttarakhand’s security agencies escalated in the intervening night of Thursday and Friday when a
stories.summary: A group of Nihang Sikhs breached police barricades at the Uttarakhand-Himachal Pradesh border and entered Dehradun, prompting a major security alert. The group, brandishing swords and kirpans, demanded the release of four arrested members. They were accommodated at Gurudwara Gobind Nagar Race Course in Dehradun, where talks with the administration took place. The standoff continued for hours before ending in the early hours of Friday after negotiations with authorities. The Nihangs had planned a protest march in Uttarakhand related to a dispute at the Karnaprayag market in Chamoli and a gurdwara in Nagrasu, but called it off. The incident follows a June 16 altercation in Chamoli, after which some Nihang members occupied a gurdwara in Nagarasu before leaving on June 23. The situation was resolved after talks between the Nihangs and the administration.

stories.headline: Siya Brother Sahil Goyal To Cops Police allege that Ketan Agarwal was pushed off a cliff at Lohagad Fort on June 18 by his fiance Siya Goyal, 20 and her alleged lover Chetan Chaudhary, 22.
stories.summary: Ketan Agarwal was allegedly pushed off a cliff at Lohagad Fort on June 18 by his fiancée Siya Goyal, 20, and her alleged lover Chetan Chaudhary, 22. Police believe the two conspired to kill Agarwal, who was engaged to Goyal and planning to marry her later in 2026. Siya Goyal has been arrested in connection with the incident. Her brother, Sahil Goyal, stated that if Siya had expressed dissatisfaction with the engagement, the family would have stopped the wedding. Sahil also knows Chetan Chaudhary, and police are investigating the circumstances surrounding the alleged murder. The incident occurred on June 18, with initial reports suggesting the death occurred on June 19, but the exact date has been confirmed as June 18.

stories.headline: Water restrictions at Antarctic station after power 'blink' Antarctica's McMurdo Station experienced a momentary power outage that now means staff are subject to water restrictions.
stories.summary: Antarctica's McMurdo Station experienced a 12-hour power outage, disrupting desalination plants and forcing researchers to rely on emergency water reserves. As a result, a 'code orange' water restriction is in place, limiting staff to two-minute showers twice a week. The station, located on the southern tip of Ross Island, is an American Antarctic research facility. The power outage, initially described as a momentary 'blink,' has had a significant impact on the station's water supply. Staff must now conserve water, with restrictions in place to ensure the emergency reserves last until the desalination plants are operational again. The station, originally established by Richard E. Byrd, is a key research facility in Antarctica, and the water restrictions will remain in place until the water supply is restored to normal levels. The restrictions are necessary to prevent a water shortage at the station.

stories.headline: Softer Q2 Earnings Outlook Might Change The Case For Investing In Steel Dynamics (STLD) Earlier this month, Steel Dynamics, Inc. issued second‑quarter 2026 guidance, projecting earnings of US$3.51 to US$3.55 per diluted share, below prior analyst e
stories.summary: Steel Dynamics, Inc. issued second-quarter 2026 guidance, projecting earnings of $3.51 to $3.55 per diluted share. This outlook is below prior analyst expectations, with a consensus estimate of $4.16. Despite the weaker-than-anticipated guidance, the projected earnings level is higher than the $2.78 in Q1 2026 and $2.01 in the prior-year second quarter. The company attributed the guidance to stronger steel and aluminum profitability. The earnings guidance is available on Steel Dynamics' website under "Investors – SEC Filings." The softer outlook may impact the case for investing in Steel Dynamics, as it falls short of Wall Street estimates. The company's actual earnings per share for Q2 2026 will be closely watched to see if they meet or exceed the guided range.

stories.headline: Microsoft Stock And 2 AI Picks Backed By Cloud And Software Demand Artificial intelligence is moving from buzzword to real-world infrastructure, touching everything from chips and cloud to software and large language models suc
stories.summary: Microsoft stock and two other AI picks are expected to benefit from growing demand for cloud and software driven by artificial intelligence. AI is becoming a core competitive advantage, transforming industries from chips and cloud infrastructure to software and automation. Top AI stocks to consider include Microsoft (MSFT) and other key players such as Google (GOOGL), Arista Networks (ANET), and Ciena (CIEN), which are also crucial cloud computing stocks. These companies are poised to gain from the increasing adoption of AI technologies, which are moving from buzzwords to real-world infrastructure. The growth of AI is driving a semiconductor rally and impacting software stocks, making these picks attractive for investment portfolios focused on emerging technologies.

stories.headline: Lithium Americas Stock And Nevada Shares Tied To The State’s AI Shift Nevada’s economy is changing fast, with AI infrastructure, lithium supply chains, and higher paying service jobs starting to share the spotlight with casino flo
stories.summary: Nevada's economy is shifting towards AI infrastructure, lithium supply chains, and higher-paying service jobs, with Lithium Americas at the forefront. The company's Thacker Pass project is a major in-state lithium development, driven by regional job and wage growth. Lithium is a key component in batteries for AI models, and Nevada's vast open land makes it an attractive location for AI-related infrastructure, including data centers. Global lithium demand is expected to increase nearly fivefold by 2040, driven by the shift to electric vehicles and clean-energy storage. Lithium Americas is set to generate significant revenue in 2028 through its joint venture with General Motors to develop and operate a commercial mine and chemical manufacturing facility. The state's mineral potential, infrastructure, and mining-friendly policies have made it a cornerstone for domestic lithium supply development.

stories.headline: Google’s Search Dominance Faces Challenges from AI Competition and User Backlash – NaturalNews.com
stories.summary: Google's long-standing search dominance is facing challenges from AI-powered rivals and a segment of users seeking alternatives. AI chatbots, such as Gemini, are emerging as competitors, offering generative capabilities to assist with tasks like writing and idea generation. Despite its current strong position, Google must remain vigilant about AI competition and legal challenges to maintain its lead. Alternative search options, like Yandex Maps, are gaining traction, allowing users to find destinations without exact addresses and providing routes for public transport, driving, or walking. The growth of AI challengers poses a threat to Google's monopoly, prompting users to explore alternative search options and potentially altering the search landscape. As a result, Google's long-term investment prospects may be impacted by its ability to adapt to these emerging challenges.

stories.headline: OpenAI limits its latest ChatGPT product to Trump-approved customers during cybersecurity review
stories.summary: OpenAI is limiting access to its new AI product, GPT-5.6 Sol, to a small group of trusted partners approved by the Trump administration. This restriction is in place during a cybersecurity review, as part of an unprecedented government vetting of AI products. The move is intended to address potential cybersecurity concerns related to the new model. OpenAI's decision to restrict access was made at the request of the Trump administration. The company's newest model, like others in the industry, will only be available to a select group of customers until the review is complete. This development marks a notable instance of government involvement in the regulation of AI products, highlighting growing concerns about the potential risks and implications of advanced artificial intelligence.

stories.headline: Apple Inc.’s top executive in charge of the Vision Pro headset and the company’s smart glasses efforts is leaving for OpenAI
stories.summary: Apple's top executive in charge of the Vision Pro headset and smart glasses efforts, Paul Meade, is leaving the company to join OpenAI. Meade, a hardware VP, spent seven years building the Vision Pro and led the smart glasses initiative. His departure comes after Apple recently increased the price of the Vision Pro to $4,000, following reportedly low sales. Meade will reunite with former Apple designers, including Jony Ive, at OpenAI. This move continues a trend of high-profile defections from Apple to rivals in the artificial intelligence and hardware sectors. Meade's exit leaves Apple without its most experienced augmented reality (AR) executive, potentially impacting the company's future AR projects, including the smart glasses initiative. The loss of Meade's expertise may raise concerns about Apple's ability to compete in the emerging AR market.

stories.headline: Tax policy for artificial intelligence should focus on where profits are created, a top OpenAI executive said Friday
stories.summary: OpenAI, the developer of ChatGPT and Dall-E, is generating $2 billion in revenue monthly. A top executive suggested that tax policy for artificial intelligence should focus on where profits are created. The company recently announced GPT-4o, a multi-modal version of its large language model, at its own event, pre-empting Google's developer conference. OpenAI's CEO, Sam Altman, believes the AI revolution is here to stay. The company's revenue and innovations have put it at a crossroads, with executives previously considering an initial public offering (IPO) before appearing to change their minds. OpenAI's growth and developments are making significant waves in the tech industry, with the company continuing to push the boundaries of artificial intelligence capabilities. Its latest text-to-speech model is also available for developers to try through an interactive demo in the OpenAI API.
